notes: The Pigeon is a highly recognisable named character and must be sourced as Mo Willems clip art — Boardmaker generic bird or pigeon will not match. Core story arc: pigeon resists bath, insists he is not dirty/smelly, eventually enjoys bath. Key vocabulary focuses on hygiene concepts (dirty, clean, smell, wash) and bath objects (tub, soap, bubbles, towel, splash). 'Wash' and 'bathe' overlap — 'bathe' Boardmaker icon may be clearer than 'wash' for this context; check existing activity_images 'wash' asset first. 'Splash' may need sourcing if not in Boardmaker library — search 'splash water'. Rubber duck is in existing activity_images but omitted from fringe_11 as less essential than core hygiene vocabulary; consider swapping 'splash' for 'rubber duck' if students respond better to concrete objects.
